name: funnel-runtime
description: Configurable multi-step funnels: versioning, rollback, A/B, idempotent events, analytics

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @funnel/server" "npm run dev -w @funnel/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @funnel/web && npm run build -w @funnel/server
